name: subject-corrected-DS1-DS2
description: Inter-patient split based on de Chazal et al. (2004) DS1/DS2, corrected so that records 201 and 202 (same subject) stay together: record 202 is moved from DS2 (test) to the training side.
subject_note: The MIT-BIH directory documents exactly one pair of recordings from the same subject (201 and 202). Every other recording is treated as its own subject, as documented by the database; identities cannot be independently verified.
